# chameleon_ontology_attributes (Data Source)

Lists every attribute defined on an ontology entity type.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_type_id` (String) Entity type whose attributes are listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
